title: Effectiveness of Annual Casino Entry Fee Paid by Singaporeans and PRs in Preventing Problem Gambling
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Annual Casino Entry Fee Paid by Singaporeans and PRs in Preventing Problem Gambling

sections.label: Casino entry levies and safeguards
sections.summary: Entry levies collected since 2010 total about $1.3 billion, fund Tote Board programmes, deter casual gambling, and the annual levy remains for now.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Since 2010, the total amount of entry levies collected is around $1.3 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The proceeds are channelled to Tote Board which funds social and community programmes that benefit the public.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The daily and annual entry levies serve to deter casual and impulse gambling by locals and are part of a holistic suite of social safeguards.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Between 2010 and 2018, the number of local visitors to the casinos declined by 50%.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Based on the most recent gambling participation survey conducted by the National Council on Problem Gambling, the probable problem and pathological gambling rate decreased from 2.6% in 2011 to 0.9% in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: On the Member's question whether we should do away with the annual entry levy, we considered this carefully and think the levy can remain for now.

sections.label: Visit limit for vulnerable persons
sections.summary: A visit limit or exclusion order will be imposed on persons assessed to be financially vulnerable.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If they are assessed to be financially vulnerable, a visit limit or exclusion order will be imposed on them.

sections.label: Exclusion order blocks entry
sections.summary: Under an exclusion order, no amount offered will get a person through.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If you are under an exclusion order, then no amount that you offer will get you through.
